external/README.txt

WHAT THIS FOLDER IS FOR
  Some things the plan needs are not files in our repos: accounts, API keys, the hosted database,
  the MCP registration on each laptop, Devpost, the table setup. Each .txt here covers one of them:
  what it is, who sets it up and when, how, and how to check that it works.

FILES
  mcp.txt                    registering our MCP server in Claude Code on each laptop
  claude-code-hooks.txt      the per-laptop hook settings, and how to check them
  spacetimedb-maincloud.txt  the hosted database: account, version, publishing, token
  github.txt                 the two repos, access, the wip/* branches, the demo-base tag
  api-keys.txt               every key: where it goes and who holds it
  factory-droid.txt          Factory account, credits, booth questions, prize rules
  devpost.txt                submission requirements and deadlines
  venue-and-hardware.txt     monitor, cables, Wi-Fi rules, what the table needs

RULE
  No secrets in these files. They are committed to repo 1, which becomes public for Devpost.
  Write down where a key lives, never the key itself.
